name: Marsha Gay Reynolds (silhouette only, NOT A LIKENESS)
depiction: Marsha Gay Reynolds, a former JetBlue flight attendant from New York, who pleaded guilty in December 2016 (federal court, Los Angeles) to conspiracy to possess with intent to distribute cocaine after she fled a crew checkpoint at LAX on 18 March 2016, leaving her bags and her heels; sentenced to time served in April 2018 after testifying against her supplier. Named because she pleaded guilty and is widely named (US Attorney's Office, AP, NBC, CBS). Drawn ONLY as a dark rim-lit silhouette in a plain dark jacket: no face, no features, no uniform, no airline insignia. NOT A LIKENESS.
